thesis: The podcast argues that while AI is reshaping education, the primary drivers of adoption are teachers rather than students, as educators seek tools to reduce administrative burdens and personalize curriculum. The discussion highlights a shift from initial skepticism to a pragmatic acceptance of AI in classrooms, noting that higher education is leading this transition while K-12 districts are moving from banning AI to proactively procuring new technologies.
